title.en: The gradient: how strong, which way

t.zh: 照片中的边缘可能朝向不同方向，如何比较它们的变化强度？<wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref>给出两个带符号的方向响应。利用<wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>，先比较响应表中不同方向和符号的变化，再构建可复用的强度元件。
t.en: Edges in a photograph can point in different directions. How can their change strengths be compared? <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> provides two signed directional responses. Using the <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>, compare directions and signs in the response table, then build a reusable strength part.

after.zh: <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref>用两个方向的响应描述局部变化：方向与非负强度是不同的信息。直接相加可能使正负响应相消，不能稳定地比较变化强度。
after.en: The <wiki-ref to="image-gradient"></wiki-ref> describes local change using two directional responses: direction and nonnegative strength convey different information. Direct addition can cancel signed responses and does not reliably compare strengths.

desc.zh: 输入一张图，使用已搭好的 <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> 部件输出每个位置的梯度幅度；图外补零。 (<wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>)
desc.en: Given an image, uses the built <wiki-ref to="sobel-filter"></wiki-ref> part to output gradient magnitude at each position, with zero <wiki-ref to="padding-border-rules"></wiki-ref>.

brief.zh: 这两行分别是三个位置的 gx 和 gy。填出这三个位置的梯度幅度；把每一列视作同一位置的一对响应。
brief.en: These rows give gx and gy at three positions. Fill the three gradient magnitudes, pairing responses within each column.

hint.zh: 把每一列看作一个箭头；转向和翻转不改变箭头长度。
hint.en: Treat each column as an arrow; rotation or reversal does not change its length.

why.zh: 直接把两行带符号的响应相加，会因方向不同得到不同甚至为负的值。三个箭头只是转了方向，比较长度时不能让它们互相抵消。
why.en: Adding the signed rows gives different values, including negative ones, depending on direction. These arrows differ only in direction; measuring length must not let their components cancel.

t.zh: 新元件<part-ref to="part:sqrt"></part-ref>给出平方根。
t.en: New part: <part-ref to="part:sqrt"></part-ref> gives the square root.

brief.zh: 输入一张图：输出每个位置的变化强度。大小相同而方向相反的响应，应得到同样的强度。
brief.en: Given an image, output change strength at each position. Equal-sized responses pointing in opposite directions must have equal strength.

hint.zh: gx、gy 有正有负；直接相加，正负会抵消。
hint.en: gx and gy can be negative; added as they are, they cancel.
